import pandas as pd

def run(inputs: dict) -> dict:
    df = inputs["invoices"].copy()

    amount = df["amount"]
    tax = df["tax"]
    due_date = df["due_date"]
    customer_ref = df["customer_ref"]

    r1 = amount.isna() | (amount < 0)
    r2 = tax.isna() | (tax < 0)

    amt_and_tax_notnull = amount.notna() & tax.notna()
    r3 = amt_and_tax_notnull & (tax > amount * 0.5)

    r4 = due_date.isna()

    ref_is_null = customer_ref.isna()
    ref_trim_empty = customer_ref.apply(
        lambda x: isinstance(x, str) and x.strip() == ""
    )
    r5 = ref_is_null | ref_trim_empty

    reason_lists = []
    for i in range(len(df)):
        codes = []
        if r1.iloc[i]:
            codes.append("AMT_BAD")
        if r2.iloc[i]:
            codes.append("TAX_BAD")
        if r3.iloc[i]:
            codes.append("TAX_EXCESS")
        if r4.iloc[i]:
            codes.append("DUE_NULL")
        if r5.iloc[i]:
            codes.append("REF_EMPTY")
        reason_lists.append(codes)

    has_fail = pd.Series([len(c) > 0 for c in reason_lists], index=df.index)
    reason_codes = pd.Series(
        ["|".join(c) for c in reason_lists], index=df.index
    )

    clean = df.loc[~has_fail].copy()

    rejects = df.loc[has_fail].copy()
    rejects["reason_codes"] = reason_codes.loc[has_fail]

    return {
        "invoices_clean": clean.reset_index(drop=True),
        "invoices_rejects": rejects.reset_index(drop=True),
    }
